title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Incredible! ☆ You won so many plushies! You could bury me under them, and nobody would even know I was there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I had no idea you were so good at crane games! You just kept dropping plushies into the prize slot one after another!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You have the awesomest, buono-est winning moves ever! ♪
